independently_checked: exact fixture/profile/family/format inventory with no failed or empty cases
clean reviewed revision and expected native platform/architecture
finite explicit loopback-only command flags and successful builds/exits
no exact uncertain versions; confidence and corpus/probe/field provenance
read-only wire requests, retained exact response prefixes and actual byte accounting
exclusions/intensity prevent retained I/O; explicit override provenance
deadline partial completion and bounded elapsed/timestamp evidence
residual_limits: Artifacts retain result payloads, not raw output envelopes/NDJSON lines: cannot independently recheck output/v11 markers, event sequence, newline framing, or terminal uniqueness.
The temporary corpus documents and complete connection logs are not retained: cannot reconstruct every custom rule or prove unlogged provider calls solely from these reports.
Reports establish fixture behavior for these reviewed builds, not authentication, vulnerability truth, exhaustive remote protocol coverage, or TLS behavior.
